exam: 2023年6月 第2套 · 仔细阅读 P2
title: The traditional school year, with three months of vacation e…

sents.en: The traditional school year, with three months of vacation every summer, was first implemented when America was an agricultural society and the summer months were needed for farm work.
sents.cn: 传统的学年——每年夏天有三个月假期——最早是在美国还是一个农业社会、夏季月份需要用于农活时实行的。

sents.en: Since then, we've completely changed as a nation.
sents.cn: 从那以后，我们作为一个国家已经彻底改变。

sents.en: Students no longer spend summers farming, but they aren't in school, either.
sents.cn: 学生不再在夏天务农，但他们也不在学校。

sents.en: The average American student receives 13 weeks off from school each calendar year·with about 11 of those during the summer.
sents.cn: 美国学生平均每个日历年有13周不上学，其中约11周在夏季。

sents.en: Few other countries have more than seven weeks off in a school calendar.
sents.cn: 几乎没有其他国家在校历上放假超过七周。

sents.en: With the U.S. lagging behind other countries in academics, it's time to consider year-round schooling.
sents.cn: 随着美国在学业上落后于其他国家，是时候考虑全年制办学了。

sents.en: One benefit of this change is that students will not fall victim to the "summer slide," or the well-documented phenomenon where students forget some of the knowledge they have acquired when too much time is taken off from school.
sents.cn: 这一改变的一个好处是，学生不会成为"暑期滑坡"的受害者——这是一种有充分文献记载的现象：离校时间太长，学生就会忘记部分已学知识。

sents.en: Decades of research shows that it can take from 8 to 13 weeks at the beginning of every school year for students to get back to where they were before the summer holiday.
sents.cn: 数十年的研究表明，在每个学年开始时，学生可能需要8到13周才能恢复到暑假前的水平。

sents.en: But year-round schooling isn't just about academics.
sents.cn: 但全年制办学不仅仅关乎学业。

sents.en: Teachers and students experience a closer relationship in year-round schools than they do in traditional schools and, in the absence of any long-term break, students do not feel detached from the school environment.
sents.cn: 在全年制学校里，师生之间的关系比传统学校更亲密；而且在没有任何长假的情况下，学生不会感到与学校环境脱节。

sents.en: These closer bonds and greater attachment pay off.
sents.cn: 这些更紧密的纽带和更强的依恋带来了回报。

sents.en: Research shows that students in year-round schools are more self-confident and feel more positive about their schooling experience.
sents.cn: 研究表明，全年制学校的学生更自信，对自己的求学经历感受也更积极。

sents.en: But don't kids need time to relax?
sents.cn: 但孩子们难道不需要时间放松吗？

sents.en: Some childhood development experts believe that time off from school is vital to healthy development as kids are not designed to spend so much of their time inside classrooms and the summer break provides a perfect opportunity to get outside.
sents.cn: 一些儿童发展专家认为，离开学校一段时间对健康成长至关重要，因为孩子天生并不适合把那么多时间待在教室里，而暑假提供了走出室内的绝佳机会。

sents.en: The problem with this argument is that most children aren't playing outside or even spending time with other kids.
sents.cn: 这一论点的问题在于，大多数孩子并没有在外面玩耍，甚至没有和其他孩子待在一起。

sents.en: While some children visit summer camps, most stay at home, watching TV or playing games on electronic devices, which hardly benefits them.
sents.cn: 虽然有些孩子去夏令营，但大多数待在家里，看电视或玩电子设备上的游戏，这几乎对他们毫无益处。

sents.en: The U.S. has changed from a farming economy to a knowledge- and innovation-based economy, so it makes sense for the school year to change as well.
sents.cn: 美国已经从农业经济转变为以知识和创新为基础的经济，因此学年也随之改变是合情合理的。
